'''February 2001 Lancaster tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Lancaster, Pennsylvania on 24 February 2001. [[James Leiser]] won it. It is known from Geoff Gallo-Cornell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1775">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-lancaster-pa-2-24-01-amish-tourneyd1775/ lancaster-pa-2-24-01-amish-tourney], DeckTech (Geoff "Loaf" Gallo-Cornell, 24 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-24-lancaster-pa-2-24-01-amish-tourneyd1775/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Lancaster, Pennsylvania
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 14
* '''Winner:''' [[James Leiser]]
